utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it’s still happening, and I’m keeping it on track.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking — what time are we meeting for it?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help—what details should I double-check for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Please double-check the drop-off location, the repair hours, and whether they need any specific parts or tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll verify the drop-off location, repair hours, and whether they need any specific parts or tools before I pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and make sure folks know where to bring things. Let me know what you want included on the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can come by late and help sort things out. Put me down for tools and small appliance repairs if that works.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That works perfectly, Dane — thank you. I’ll put you down for tools and small appliance repairs and note that you’ll be there late to help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a better picture now—folks are lining up small fixes for Saturday, and I can lend a drill if anyone needs one.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s helpful, thanks—I’d love to spread the word and let people know about the drill too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure—what’s the repair drive update?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I haven’t had a chance to sort mine yet, but I’m still planning to bring something by. I’ll let you know once I’ve got it together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—just keep me posted. Even a small item helps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll pass the repair drive plan along to everyone nearby.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll make sure everyone nearby hears about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli, the repair drive’s coming together nicely—want me to put your name on the invite list and spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please put my name on it and spread the word. Just let me know the time and place, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put your name down and spread the word. I’ll let you know the time and place as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely — folks are pitching in with tools, supplies, and a whole lot of good will.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s great to hear — I knew this neighborhood would show up. I’m still trying to remember what I promised to bring, but I’ll pitch in somehow.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s the spirit, Oren — even a hand, a box of tape, or a bit of time helps plenty. If you remember what you promised, I’ll spread the word so we can keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive details first. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m thinking late afternoon, maybe around 4:30, but I’m still trying to pin down the exact timing and where we should meet.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 could work for me if we keep it near the school or somewhere easy for pickup. Let me know the exact spot once you’ve got it pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, that’d help a lot—just let me know if you hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do I need to know?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s this Saturday by the community hall — we’re collecting tools, spare parts, and donations. If you can swing by, even for a little while, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — Saturday at the community hall. I can stop by for a bit and bring a few tools and a donation.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Cleo — are we still on for the repair drive, and what time should I bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, we’re still on — bring the tools around 10 a.m. and I’ll have the supplies ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be there at 10 with the tools. Do you want me to bring anything else?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the exact time, where we’re meeting, and what tools I should bring so I can plan properly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I don’t have the full details yet, but I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. Once you know, please send me the time, meeting spot, and any tool list so I can get everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, this repair drive is actually happening, right? Just want to make sure I’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s happening — we’re setting up the repair drive for this weekend. I can bring my toolkit if you want.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, I just wanted to confirm it’s really on for this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs doing first, and when should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start by listing the broken items and who can handle each one, then we can set a time to meet and split the errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me—let’s make the list first, then pick a meeting time and divide the errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive, and I’ll pass the plan along to the neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh wonderful, Vik — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep everyone posted and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep sharing the plan with the neighbors and check back if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Rosa, you should come by the repair drive later—it's a good chance to get things fixed and catch up with everyone. I’ll spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll come by and help keep things organized. It’ll be nice to see everyone and get a few repairs sorted.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Rosa — thank you! I’ll let the others know you’re helping, and I’m sure it’ll make the whole repair drive run smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive needs me most?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We could really use help sorting donated tools and matching them to the repair lists.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can do that — point me to the tools and repair lists.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep things low-key right now. Tell me where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Uli — low-key is perfect. If you can handle the pickup run after school, that would help me most.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do the pickup run after school. Just send me the details, and I’ll keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you start by checking if we need any tools or spare parts?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll check what tools and spare parts we’re short on and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supplies list here, Bo — what’s still missing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still missing the exact list — can you just tell me the main things we need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — we need lumber, nails, screws, tarps, duct tape, and a few hand tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect people for the repair drive—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Start with folks who’ve mentioned broken stuff lately, then the people on the block who are usually willing to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll start with neighbors who’ve mentioned repairs and then check in with the usual helpers on the block.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the latest, but I’m glad folks are pitching in. Did the repair drive get the parts it needed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think so, yeah — folks brought in a good stack of parts. I’m not totally sure we’ve got everything, but it’s looking a lot better now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. If you want, I can stop by and help sort through what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think I saw something about it, but I might’ve missed the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can check the details first so we don’t miss anything. If you remember where you saw it, I’ll compare notes with you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Hana — I might’ve seen a flyer or a neighborhood post, but I’m not sure. I’ll think about where I spotted it and tell you if it comes back to me.
